description: Mark inbox items as handled — privately. Advances your local watermark so inbox view='new' stops reporting them. Invisible to Slack: no read receipts, no presence signal. (mark-read is the public counterpart.)

handle.description: A handle from an inbox event.

handles.description: Several handles from inbox events, dismissed together.

scope.description: The scope whose position to advance. Must match the inbox view='new' call that produced the handles.

name: dismiss
